name: Prosynth
description: Prosynth's identity as an expert network and its services could not be verified from accessible primary or reputable sources in the November 2026 review.
overview: Public-source verification remains incomplete as of 11 November 2026. The reviewed sources did not establish the identity of an expert network called Prosynth or substantiate the previous company, service, AI, pricing and compliance claims. Those claims have been removed or marked as not disclosed.
caveats: The provider's identity and capabilities remain unverified.
No material developments from 11 November 2025 to 11 November 2026 could be verified for this provider; this does not establish that none occurred.
sourceNotes: Inex One directory — https://inex.one/expert-network-directory — read 2026-11-11. The directory landing page did not substantiate the existing Prosynth profile; it is paginated and is not evidence that the provider does not exist.

Inex One directory, page 7 — https://inex.one/expert-network-directory/page/7 — read 2026-11-11. The alphabetical section covering provider names beginning with P did not list Prosynth. The previous claim of an Inex One profile could not be substantiated.

Companies House — https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/03615916 — read 2026-11-11. PROSYNTH LIMITED is registered for chemical manufacturing. This record does not establish the identity of the described expert network, so its company facts were not transferred to this profile.

Mycrolance — https://mycrolance.com/resources/prosynth — read 2026-11-11. Opening the URL returned a generic expert-consulting guide rather than provider-specific documentation. It was not accepted as evidence for the previous profile claims. Verification remains incomplete and lastUpdated has not been advanced.
